say:1:1910307001:1.text: Mother Coral is riddled with fractures. It can no longer contain the energy within.
say:1:1910307001:1.source_cn: 母瑚本体破碎，无法承受其中蕴含的能量。

say:2:1910307002:1.text: Once all the energy escapes, it will... wither and die.
say:2:1910307002:1.source_cn: 一旦能量彻底逸散，母瑚……会彻底枯死。

say:5:1910307004:1.text: Come on, enough with the doom and gloom! You guys are scaring the children.
say:5:1910307004:1.source_cn: 我说，别这么悲观行不行？瞧瞧，都快把小孩吓哭了！

say:6:1910307005:1.text: Listen, I swam around just now and found traces of energy still lingering in the city.
say:6:1910307005:1.source_cn: 我跟着游出去看了，能量还没有完全逸散出城。

say:7:1910307006:1.text: That energy belongs to Mother Coral, right? So with Mother Coral broken, where do you think it will go next?
say:7:1910307006:1.source_cn: 它们天生属于母瑚，就算暂时失去载体，也会被吸引到那些母...

say:9:1910307007:1.text: I believe the energy must have flowed into the three Coral Sprouts.
say:9:1910307007:1.source_cn: 那些能量应该暂时依附在城内的三枝子瑚上了。

say:11:1910307008:1.text: Mother Coral? Coral Sprouts? I'm lost here! Someone fill me in so I can help!
say:11:1910307008:1.source_cn: 母瑚？子瑚？这都是什么啊？说清楚咱才好帮忙！

say:12:1910307009:1.text: Easy there, fluffy child. I'll explain.
say:12:1910307009:1.source_cn: 不要着急，毛绒孩子，阿嬷给你解释。

say:13:1910307010:1.text: Mother Coral is a giant coral that nourishes the Cradle Pool. Its corallum spreads throughout Coralia, and three of its branches rise through the rocks to form the Coral Sprouts.
say:13:1910307010:1.source_cn: 母瑚是滋养着繁育池的这棵巨型珊瑚，它的骨骼遍布塔拉萨的...

say:14:1910307011:1.text: Simply put, the Coral Sprouts are branches of Mother Coral, and they're all connected. If we can channel the energy pooled around them back into Mother Coral, we can revive it.
say:14:1910307011:1.source_cn: 简单来说，子瑚就是母瑚的分枝，彼此相互连通。只要将子瑚...

say:16:1910307012:1.text: Ah, you're that little fellow from the surface! No wonder you know nothing about Mother Coral.
say:16:1910307012:1.source_cn: 哟，我说怎么塔拉萨还有人不知道这些，仔细一看，这不是陆...

say:17:1910307013:1.text: Wait... What are you two still doing here? I thought Menoa already sent you back!
say:17:1910307013:1.source_cn: 你俩怎么还在这？摩淖亚不是送你们回去了吗？

say:20:1910307015:1.text: My friends, shouldn't we be focusing on Mother Coral rather than giving these two children a hard time?
say:20:1910307015:1.source_cn: 老友们，比起为难两个孩子，眼下最要紧难道不是修复母瑚吗？

say:21:1910307016:1.text: The Coral Sprouts can't retain energy the way Mother Coral can. Every moment we delay, more of it slips away.
say:21:1910307016:1.source_cn: 子瑚无法像母瑚这样保存能量。再拖下去，它会彻底逸散。

say:22:1910307017:1.text: ... I agree, Menoa. We can deal with these outsiders once we've resolved the crisis.
say:22:1910307017:1.source_cn: ……我同意，摩淖亚。等繁育池修复完毕，再探讨这件事。

say:23:1910307018:1.text: Now, besides recovering the energy, we also need to repair Mother Coral and the Cradle Pool.
say:23:1910307018:1.source_cn: 除了回收能量，还需要有人修复母瑚与池体。

say:28:1910307021:1.text: There's nothing <style="stress"><player_name></style> can't handle! We can count on him!
say:28:1910307021:1.male: There's nothing <style="stress"><player_name></style> can't handle! We can count on him!
say:28:1910307021:1.female: There's nothing <style="stress"><player_name></style> can't handle! We can count on her!

say:29:1910307022:1.text: Have faith in us, Uncle Corvalli! We'll bring the energy back to Mother Coral!
say:29:1910307022:1.source_cn: 壳拉流斯大伯，你们就留在这里修复繁育池，等我们把能量带...

say:31:1910307023:1.text: Why are we still standing around chatting? Let's move!
say:31:1910307023:1.source_cn: 咱急得要死了，你们还有空聊天？

say:32:1910307024:1.text: Never mind them, big guy. Just tell me what to do!
say:32:1910307024:1.source_cn: 别管他们！大个子，你来说，要从哪开始？

choice_prompt:33:1910307024.text: Never mind them, big guy. Just tell me what to do!
choice_prompt:33:1910307024.source_cn: 别管他们！大个子，你来说，要从哪开始？

say:34:1910307025:1.text: I know what you're talking about! That Coral Sprout is just south of my place.
say:34:1910307025:1.source_cn: 我知道！那是我家附近的子瑚，就在我家南边。

choice:33:0:1.text: Let's check out that glowing thing we saw earlier.
choice:33:0:1.source_cn: 去找刚刚还在闪烁光芒的那个
choice:33:0:1.male: Let's check out that glowing thing we saw earlier.
choice:33:0:1.female: Let's check out that glowing thing we saw earlier.

choice:33:1:2.text: Let's round up the traces of energy first.
choice:33:1:2.source_cn: 先去收集正在逸散的能量
choice:33:1:2.male: Let's round up the traces of energy first.
choice:33:1:2.female: Let's round up the traces of energy first.

choice:25:0:1.text: I can help collect the energy.
choice:25:0:1.male: I can help collect the energy.
choice:25:0:1.female: I can help collect the energy.

choice:25:1:2.text: The rest of you can stay behind and fix the Cradle Pool.
choice:25:1:2.source_cn: 你们留在这里修复繁育池
choice:25:1:2.male: The rest of you can stay behind and fix the Cradle Pool.
choice:25:1:2.female: The rest of you can stay behind and fix the Cradle Pool.
